items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I made the George Girard and the Jack Delaney and the George Lewis. By the way, I recorded George Lewis in the studio.

ctx.x: Even Al Hurt never recorded before you did, did he?

That's right. I gave Al Hurt his first break on the Southland label. Pete Fountain fronted his first band on my little label. Jack Delaney, Raymond Boyk. Well, there's a lot of fellas that got their first start with Southland. And they went on to bigger and better things with different recording companies. I have all of them, like Johnny Wig, Sharky, Santo Pacora. And most of the top, not most, but all the top boys around New Orleans. My only regret is that I wasn't able to get Paul, my brother. Paul passed on,…
Mind you, the beginning of your life, the starting, when you were born, where you were raised, what part of town and all? A little bit about your father and your family.
